title: Phase 6 O-07 body-length probe result
description: A SIBLING of spike-result.schema.json, never a reuse of it. Phase 0's schema is shaped around a `spike` id, a `thresholds_set` enum closed over Phase 0's own threshold names, and a `measurements` ARRAY of name/value/unit triples. O-07 asks a different question with a different shape: four named encodings, five byte counts each, and one verdict per READ PATH. Folding it into the Phase 0 schema would have required widening that closed threshold enum, which is the one edit Pitfall 7 and D-21 both exist to prevent.

probe.description: The Phase 6 open question this artifact answers. O-07 is the only one that writes into this schema today; the pattern admits a sibling rather than hard-coding one literal.

status.description: `not_run` is a FIRST-CLASS terminal state, not a failure dressed up. D-23: a leg that could not run is recorded with its reason and never as a pass.

reason.description: REQUIRED when status is `not_run`. What made the measurement unreachable, in words a later reader can act on.

listen.description: 127.0.0.1 ONLY, and never port 8080 — that is the operator's live desktop instance.

plugins.description: What was installed into the instance for this run, and what each one was for. A measurement taken through a plugin nobody can identify is not re-runnable.

byte_len_mismatch.description: counters.byteLenMismatch read off the SHIPPED plugin's getStatus after the consumer drained. Its own JSDoc in packages/backend/src/telemetry.ts states what a non-zero value means: the hook's Body.length disagreed with toRaw().length on the reloaded response.

reload_pairs_compared.description: NON-VACUITY for byte_len_mismatch. Zero comparisons and zero mismatches are the same number, and only one of them is evidence.

pathVerdict.description: `not_measured` is not a hedge — it is the honest answer for a read path this run could not exercise, and it must stay distinguishable from a measured `identity`.

fixture.description: The fixture NAME only. Never a path and never a URL — this artifact is committed.

identity_byte_len.description: The decompressed byte count, taken from corpus/encoded/fixtures.json which the generator computed from the file itself. This is the number every other count in this block is compared AGAINST.

hook_body_length.description: Body.length as onInterceptResponse saw it. Recorded for continuity with the hook path, NOT as evidence about either read path.

reload_raw_length.description: toRaw().length on the response returned by sdk.requests.get(id) — the get() read path.

query_body_length.description: Body.length on the response returned by sdk.requests.query().…execute() — the query() read path, the half that matters for the retro scan.

wire_byte_len.description: What the origin actually put on the wire for this encoding. The COMPETING hypothesis: a count equal to this rather than to identity_byte_len is the 7.25x hole.

reload_body_length.description: Body.length (rather than toRaw().length) on the get() path, recorded so the two spellings can be told apart.

query_raw_length.description: toRaw().length on the query() path, for the same reason.
